claims.claim_text_normalized: CornerNet detects objects as a pair of keypoints, the top-left and bottom-right corners, using a single convolutional network.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We propose CornerNet, a new approach to object detection where we detect an object bounding box as a pair of keypoints, the top-left corner and the bottom-right corner, using a single convolution neural network.

claims.claim_text_normalized: CornerNet eliminates the need for designing anchor boxes used in prior single-stage detectors.
claims.evidence_quote_short: By detecting objects as paired keypoints, we eliminate the need for designing a set of anchor boxes commonly used in prior single-stage detectors.

claims.claim_text_normalized: CornerNet introduces corner pooling, a new pooling layer that helps the network better localize corners.
claims.evidence_quote_short: In addition to our novel formulation, we introduce corner pooling, a new type of pooling layer that helps the network better localize corners.

claims.claim_text_normalized: CornerNet achieves a 42.2% AP on MS COCO, outperforming all existing one-stage detectors.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Experiments show that CornerNet achieves a 42.2% AP on MS COCO, outperforming all existing one-stage detectors.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The use of anchor boxes in prior detectors creates a huge imbalance between positive and negative anchor boxes and slows down training.
claims.evidence_quote_short: As a result, only a tiny fraction of anchor boxes will overlap with ground truth; this creates a huge imbalance between positive and negative anchor boxes and slows down training.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Corner pooling significantly improves AP by 2.0% on MS COCO validation.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Tab. 1 shows that adding corner pooling gives significant improvement: 2.0% on AP, 2.1% on AP 50 and 2.1% on AP 75.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The hourglass network is crucial to the performance of CornerNet.
claims.evidence_quote_short: The results suggest that the choice of the backbone network is important and the hourglass network is crucial to the performance of CornerNet.

claims.claim_text_normalized: CornerNet is able to generate bounding boxes of higher quality compared to other state-of-the-art detectors.
claims.evidence_quote_short: This suggests that CornerNet is able to generate bounding boxes of higher quality compared to other state-of-the-art detectors.
